combo_label: Hairdressers × Hot Air Balloons × Roald Dahl

entries.clue: Lattice tower carrying power lines, the great hazard when coming down
Cutter of men's hair, once also a puller of teeth
Freehand sweeping of lightener down the lengths, sun-kissed effect
Wager of a car against a boy's finger over ten flicks of a lighter
Guzzling glutton who leans too far over the river and plugs a pipe
Sharp pull on a line, or a stubby boat that hauls big ships
False peeper a spiteful wife drops into her husband's mug of beer
The person whose ground you have just come down on, to be squared with
To go only where the moving air decides, with no steering of your own
Quick sluice of clean water to clear the lather away
Long-billed bird whose pouch does the bucket work for window cleaners
Wrapped turban-style around your head as you leave the basin
